facts.fact: UNECA's APAI-CRVS costed strategic plan lists Eritrea as 'Not initiated' in its table of countries' CRVS comprehensive assessment and planning status, with no plan entry beside it; the table gives no date, so the published date is used, and its column headings are not in the passages.
facts.system: Civil registration and vital statistics system

note: The only passage naming Eritrea is one table row; the reading of its columns rests on the neighbouring Ethiopia row ('Comprehensive assessment completed', 'Developed').
